10 Alleged Drug Peddlers Arrested in Anantnag, Narcotics Seized

Anantnag police in Kashmir arrested 10 individuals alleged to be drug peddlers within a single day. Among those arrested, two are from West Bengal. Narcotics valued at "lakhs" were seized during the operation. The specific amount and type of narcotics were not detailed in the coverage.
